name: Rosette
description: John Whitney Sr.'s Arabesque (1975) morphing emblem, rendered as real 3D lit geometry (WHIT.2b): the two-term epicycle z(t)=e^{it}+a*e^{-i(n-1)t} (n dynamic: 5/6/4) swept into a genuine tube with PBR lighting/AO/IBL, tightening into a straight-edged pentagon and unravelling into an open tangle. Mirrored coloured wing-arc tubes with small ellipse loops frame the figure (D-217: full cartouche). tonalConsonance sets the tighten/unravel position (a plain clock is the floor drift when consonance signal is weak); bassDev swells stroke presence; midAttRel scales the floor-drift rate; tonalPhaseFifths (circularly smoothed) rotates the figure only; harmonicFlux steps the symmetry order (5->6->4) via a smooth multi-second transition (WHIT.2a), held for tens of seconds. See docs/presets/ROSETTE_DESIGN.md and docs/ENGINEERING_PLAN.md Phase WHIT.
author: Matt
